# Response to RFQ VPK-2026-014 — Technical maintenance, warehouse and logistics properties

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

LUSA qualification held for the relevant field. Liability insurance cover exceeds EUR 1,000,000. Turnover in the most recent financial year exceeds EUR 5,000,000.

## Technical response

**Occupational safety plan.** A site-specific occupational safety plan is enclosed, backed by our NMSB 75310:2018 and NOHS 61810 occupational health and safety certifications, covering the hazards specific to warehouse and logistics environments.

**Condition-monitoring data.** Measurements taken at each visit — temperatures, pressures, running hours as applicable to each system — are logged and reported to the buyer following each scheduled visit, giving a running record of equipment condition over the contract term.

**Environmental matters.** Waste is segregated by type, hazardous substances are handled under our environmental management system, and spill-prevention measures are applied at all three sites, including containment for refrigerant handling.

**Quality control and testing.** Work is delivered under our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, with testing carried out at each maintenance visit and non-conformities logged and closed out.

**Preventive maintenance plan.** A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for the systems covered by the contract, scheduling inspection and servicing ahead of likely failure points rather than waiting for faults to be reported.

**HVAC maintenance agreement.** The proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, cleaning and performance checks across all three sites, with the scope adjusted to each site's equipment.

**Personnel qualifications.** All personnel working on site hold the occupational cards and trade certificates the work requires, including subcontracted staff where used.

**Building automation compatibility.** Our systems are compatible with BACnet/Modbus building automation, allowing integration with the buyer's existing platform without additional gateway hardware.

**Routine maintenance visits.** A fixed visit calendar is proposed, with content and scheduling set out per site and confirmed with the site contact ahead of each visit.

**Service-level targets.** SLA targets are proposed for each of the three sites, differentiated where site criticality or equipment age warrants it.

## Commercial terms

Proposed contract period as set out in Section 1, with the extension option accepted. Our proposed limitation-of-liability clause is enclosed. A bonus/malus arrangement is proposed against the service levels above. Pricing structure: fixed price per site.

## Forms enclosed

List of subcontractors (Liite 3); completed Reference Form (Liite 2); completed Tender Form (Liite 1).

## Format

Font size throughout is 11pt or larger. Reference currency is EUR. The document does not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices. Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not on a monthly basis.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Lift maintenance is carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection requirements. Fault reports outside normal working hours are covered by our standby (on-call) arrangement, with a defined response-time commitment applying evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Visakoivu Oy
